notes.title: Minor patch released (1.0.1 -> 1.0.2)
notes.content:
While still working on a new gameplay mode (anyone interested in Arcade point hunting? ːsteamhappyː), yet another minor patch is released. This patch addresses the following issues:

[list]
    [*][b]Bugfix:[/b] Fixed an issue with Consumer enemy type in the [b]City of Dis[/b] area. Sometimes, the enemy would get stuck and block progress.
    [*][b]Bugfix:[/b] Fixed a few minor issues with sound
    [*][b]Bugfix:[/b] Fixed a few quality issues with textures and fonts, especially for high resolution displays.
    [*][b]Improvement:[/b] Optimized performance, especially for the final boss battle.
[/list]

notes.title: Minor patch released (1.0.0 -> 1.0.1)
notes.content:
Another patch has been released, which addresses the following issues:

 [list]
    [*][b]Bugfix[/b]: Fixed a critical issue that would crash the game with the message 'Too many threads' on rare occasions.
    [*][b]Bugfix[/b]: Fixed an issue where music volume would be wrong near loudspeakers in 'into the dead land'
    [*][b]Bugfix[/b]: Fixed a few issues with sounds (work in progress)
    [*][b]Improvement[/b]: Optimized performance (work in progress)
[/list]

This patch will not be the last; apart from more bugfixes and improvements, we're also planning new features ... but more on that later ːsteammockingː

notes.title: Minor patch released (0.9.9 -> 1.0.0)
notes.content:
We're happy to announce that a minor patch has been released, which addresses the following issues:

[list]
    [*][b]Bugfix[/b]: Destroying machinery in 'bring out your dead' would render the player unable to progress under certain circumstances.
    [*][b]Bugfix[/b]: Loudspeakers in 'into the dead land' would not mutter their nonsense sometimes.
    [*][b]Bugfix[/b]: Fixed an issue with sound when firing the lightning gun.
    [*][b]Improvement[/b]: Several aesthetic improvements in a bunch of maps (tile placements, ...)
    [*][b]Improvement[/b]: Minor rework done on the main menu (work in progress)
    [*][b]Improvement[/b]: Tweaked balance a bit when rocket launchers play 'boom' with soldiers.
[/list]

Let the slaughter continue!
